# bounded-work-channel

Behavior contract:
channel/service.cjs exports Channel, a bounded FIFO async channel. new Channel(capacity) requires a positive integer, otherwise RangeError. async send(value) resolves when value is handed to a waiting receiver or enqueued; when full it waits, preserving sender order, until capacity becomes available. async receive() returns {value,done:false}; when open and empty it waits, preserving receiver order. Any JS value, including undefined/false/0, is data. close() is synchronous and idempotent: reject all waiting senders and future sends with Error('closed'), preserve queued data for draining, and settle waiting receivers with {value:undefined,done:true} when empty. After the closed buffer is drained, every receive returns done:true. No value from a rejected sender may be delivered. Operations must leave no unsettled waiter after closure.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
